unmapped_blocks.text: SUMMARY5
Project management
Key Achievements
Achieved a 40% reduction in data processing time by optimizingPySpark
jobs and improving pipeline performance.
Directed the migration of a legacy data warehouse to AWS,
enhancing system scalability, reliability, and maintainability whilerealizing
a 30% reduction in operational costs and streamliningcross
-departmental migration activities.
Possess extensive Azure-based data engineering expertise,
covering end-to-end management of data pipelines, productionsupport
, data modeling, and release management; successfullydelivered
20 major releases with an 80% on-time delivery rate.
Led Scrum-driven sprint teams, translating business requirementsinto
precise user stories, coordinating development efforts, andensuring
high-quality deliverables with over 95% defect-freeperformance
Proficient in a wide range of Azure tools and services, includingAzure
Data Lake Storage (ADLS Gen2), Azure Virtual Machines,
Azure Synapse Analytics (Serverless & Dedicated SQL Pools),
Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Azure Functions, and PowerBI
; highly skilled in Spark, Python, Scala, and workflow orchestrationplatforms
such as Apache Airflow.
delivery capacity while modernizing the existing data ecosystem.
SolutionWe
designed and developed a scalable, cloud-native data andanalytics
platform on Microsoft Azure. The solution included buildingreusable
PySpark-based data processing frameworks and executingthe
end-to-end migration of workflows from the on-premises Hiveenvironment
to Azure services. Leveraged Azure Data Lake Storage
(ADLS Gen2) for scalable storage, Azure Databricks for distributedprocessing
, and Azure Data Factory for orchestrating ingestion andtransformation
pipelines.
October 2015 - October 2017Senior
Software Engineer|WiproJune
2011 - October 2015Production
Support Engineer|Accenture Service Pvt Ltd.
Gathered and analyzed business and technical requirements todesign
the overall data ingestion and transformation solution.
Performed end-to-end data engineering activities, includingingestion
, processing, transformation, and validation across the datalifecycle
Collected data
from RDBMS sources using Sqoop and ingested itinto
HDFS for downstream processing.
Developed and optimized Hive scripts, queries, and action workflowsto
implement transformation logic and ensure data quality.
Developed ETL jobs using Talend Studio, performed unit testing, anddeployed
the jobs to the Talend Production Server following releasemanagement
practices.
Configured and monitored job scheduling through Control-M,
ensuring timely execution, handling reruns, and managing jobdependencies
Collaborated with Business, QA, and Operations teams to supporttesting
, perform defect resolution, and ensure smooth deploymentinto
production.
